title: A quarter-table change from a group to a classical Moufang loop of order 16
scope: F_2^4 and the cubic code loop on F_2^3 x F_2 are Moufang loops with common identity, associators with images of size 1 and 2 (inequivalent under pointed, unpointed and independent bijective readings), and table distance 64 < 3*16^2/8 = 96; refutes Drapal-Vojtechovsky Conjecture 11.2 in its stated unrestricted scope.
source_targets: Drapal-Vojtechovsky, Moufang loops that share associator and three quarters of their multiplication tables, Rocky Mountain J. Math. 36 (2006) 425-455; arXiv:math/0701710 Conjecture 11.2
substantive_reason: The source studies which quarter-table modifications preserve associators, conjectures that changing the associator needs distance >= 3n^2/8, and asks for quarter-table constructions changing the associator; the witness supplies one. The loop itself is classical; credit is for the explicit refutation.
